RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be reliably estimated from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth noting as a governance issue, but it does not itself show that sex influenced this decision. Both you and the successful candidate are men; nothing provided establishes sex-based treatment.

Focus first on the selection criteria, scoring, interview assessments and how qualifications and experience were weighed. The announcement alone cannot establish who was better qualified.

Follow up your unanswered request and check applicable response deadlines, recruitment rules and appeal time limits. Raise panel composition specifically if those rules require gender balance, or if further evidence suggests bias. A procedural breach could matter independently of discrimination.
